name: press-print
description: Source-aware visual reconstruction for transforming photographs into contemporary print-driven compositions.

interface.longDescription: Press-Print transforms a user-supplied source photograph into a contemporary print-driven editorial composition while preserving the structures that make the scene recognizable. It rebuilds the source through selective cropping, layered planes, halftone and duotone treatment, flat graphic fields, controlled collage, graphic reduction, and modernist hierarchy rather than applying a uniform filter. Press-Print v1.0 is image-only and does not invent captions, place names, dates, slogans, labels, or decorative text.
defaultPrompt: Rebuild this city photo as an editorial print composition. Keep the skyline readable.
Turn this portrait into a Press-Print reconstruction. No text.
